story.title: The Automatic Onion-Crying Goggles
story.question: Can an overly emotional kitchen gadget save a failing vegetable stall?
story.answer: Yes, by generating synthetic tears that keep onions hydrated and fresh all day long.

story_beats.headline: The Sizzling Invention
story_beats.speech: Behold the tear-duct regulator! It senses vegetable melancholy and soothes them with pure hydration instantly.
story_beats.label: The Contraption Reveal
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby stands proudly behind his wooden market stall, holding a clunky copper robot-goggle device dripping with salty water, surrounded by confused vegetable vendors.

story_beats.headline: The Flooding Market
story_beats.speech: Oh dear, the sensitivity dial is stuck on maximum! The entire carrot section is completely underwater now!
story_beats.label: The Mechanism Spikes
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby frantically twists a glowing red dial on the copper goggles while rushing through a knee-high wave of vegetable rinse water inside the crowded market square.

story_beats.headline: The Desperate Adaptation
story_beats.speech: Quickly grab the spare copper tubing! We must channel this salty overflow directly onto the parsnips!
story_beats.label: The Emergency Build
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby and his niece rapidly solder a network of curved copper tubes resembling ship rigging above the root vegetable crates to drain the excess liquid.

story_beats.headline: The Crisp Victory
story_beats.speech: Look at those shiny, perfectly misted turnips! The tourists are buying every single vegetable we own today!
story_beats.label: The Market Payoff
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby smiles broadly as a line of cheerful tourists eagerly buy glowing, perfectly misted root vegetables from his dry, bustling market stall decorated with green leafy garlands.

story.central_conflict: Barnaby invention creates too many fake tears, flooding the bustling morning market stalls.
story.decisive_choice: Barnaby diverts the excess salty moisture into small misting tubes above the root vegetable crates.
story.resolution: The root vegetables remain remarkably crisp, attracting double the usual weekend tourist crowd.

visual_bible.style: vibrant, whimsical stop-motion animation aesthetic with warm lighting and detailed textures

characters.Barnaby: An elderly inventor with wild grey hair, round brass spectacles, a stained green apron, and ink-stained fingers.
characters.Niece: A resourceful teenager with braided brown hair, denim overalls, and a tool belt filled with tiny spanners.

locations.Market Square: A bustling, sunlit cobblestone marketplace filled with striped awnings, wooden crates, and shouting vendors.

objects.Goggles: A bulky copper contraption with glass lenses, glowing red indicator lights, and a dripping rubber nozzle.
objects.Copper Tubing: Shiny, flexible metal pipes used to redirect liquids around the busy market stall.

story.title: The Drift Engine Disagreement
story.question: Should the crew purge the primary coolant to outrun a solar flare?
story.answer: They bypassed the manual purge and rerouted excess heat through the ballast tanks instead.

story_beats.headline: Overheat Warning
story_beats.speech: Captain Vane, we must purge the primary coolant now or the main reactor will melt down completely.
story_beats.label: Reactor Core
story_beats.visual_prompt: Chief engineer Jax points at a flashing red diagnostic console inside the vibrating bridge, wearing grease-stained overalls and a worried expression.

story_beats.headline: The Cargo Risk
story_beats.speech: If we purge the coolant, our delicate biological cargo will perish before we reach the outer colony.
story_beats.label: Cargo Bay
story_beats.visual_prompt: First officer Lyra stands inside the dimly lit cargo bay, holding a glowing biometric datapad while shaking her head firmly at Jax.

story_beats.headline: Alternative Routing
story_beats.speech: We can siphon the thermal overload into the empty water ballast tanks without losing our precious cargo.
story_beats.label: Maintenance Deck
story_beats.visual_prompt: Jax activates a utility robot in the metallic maintenance deck, programming a secondary valve diversion on a holographic touchscreen.

story_beats.headline: Safe Escape
story_beats.speech: The ballast tanks absorbed the excess heat safely, and we are now accelerating clear of the solar flare.
story_beats.label: Observation Dome
story_beats.visual_prompt: Vane and Lyra smile together inside the sunlit observation dome, watching a distant green planet as the ship cruises through calm space.

story.resolution: Safe escape from the solar flare

visual_bible.style: Clean, colorful sci-fi animation with high contrast and detailed mechanical textures.

characters.Vane: A tall captain with a neat gray beard, wearing a crisp dark blue uniform jacket with brass rank pins.
characters.Jax: A sturdy engineer with a leather tool belt, wearing smudged orange overalls and protective goggles pushed up on a curly brown forehead.
characters.Lyra: An observant officer with silver-streaked dark hair tied back tightly, wearing a teal utility vest over a gray jumpsuit.

locations.Bridge: A curved chamber featuring glowing amber instrument panels, overhead steel girders, and panoramic windows facing open space.
locations.Cargo Bay: A vast, chilly compartment lined with stacked stasis pods glowing in soft blue hues.
locations.Maintenance Deck: A cramped, utilitarian space filled with exposed copper pipes, blinking circuit panels, and heavy tool racks.
locations.Observation Dome: A spacious half-sphere room with polished metallic flooring and comfortable padded seating benches.

objects.Biometric Datapad: A thin rectangular glass slate displaying moving green heartbeat waveforms and inventory numbers.
objects.Utility Robot: A compact rolling cylinder with three articulated mechanical arms and a single rotating blue optical sensor.
objects.Diagnostic Console: A sunken terminal set into the bulkhead with tactile black buttons and an oversized red warning beacon.

story.title: The Infinite Pancake-Flidder Debacle
story.question: Can Barnaby sell his hyper-kinetic batter launcher before the morning market inspector condemns his stall?
story.answer: Yes, by accidentally launching breakfast directly into the inspector's mouth, winning a culinary medal instead of a fine.

story_beats.headline: The Morning Inspection
story_beats.speech: Behold the marvellous mechanical pancake flipper, designed to feed this entire bustling market in under four seconds flat!
story_beats.label: The Flidder Reveal
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby stands proudly inside his cluttered market stall, pointing at a metallic spring-loaded pancake flipper while the stern inspector writes on a clipboard.

story_beats.headline: Fermented Fury
story_beats.speech: Oh dear, the batter has fermented faster than anticipated, expanding inside the titanium chamber with alarming rhythmic ticking noises.
story_beats.label: Pressure Build
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby frantically twists a brass valve on the vibrating machine as angry green bubbles swell and steam hisses from the silver canister.

story_beats.headline: The Breakfast Barrage
story_beats.speech: Duck and cover, everyone, because the automated mechanism has decided to distribute breakfast across every single vegetable cart!
story_beats.label: Kinetic Mechanism
story_beats.visual_prompt: Golden pancakes fly wildly through the crowded market air, striking market umbrellas and landing neatly atop stacks of fresh cabbages.

story_beats.headline: A Sweet Victory
story_beats.speech: Well, I must admit this unconventional delivery method is surprisingly delicious, so I hereby award your stall first prize!
story_beats.label: Pancake Payoff
story_beats.visual_prompt: The inspector happily catches a falling pancake in his open mouth while Barnaby wipes flour from his brow and smiles in relief.

story.central_conflict: Barnaby tests a high-speed spring-loaded pancake flipper inside a cramped, crowded public market stall.
story.decisive_choice: Barnaby pulls the emergency maximum-velocity lever to clear a backlog of fermented dough.
story.resolution: The airborne pancakes form a delicious canopy over the market, delighting the inspector and saving the business.

visual_bible.style: Bright, whimsical stop-motion claymation aesthetic with vibrant primary colors and highly detailed textures.

characters.Barnaby: An eager inventor with wild ginger hair, smudged round spectacles, a flour-dusted green apron, and a perpetually surprised expression.
characters.Inspector: A stern municipal official with a waxed handlebar mustache, a stiff blue uniform, and a severe scowl.

locations.MarketStall: A crowded wooden booth overflowing with sacks of flour, copper pots, and hanging ladles in the center of a busy cobblestone town square.

objects.PancakeFlidder: A contraption made of shiny brass gears, a red rubber squeeze bulb, and a spring-loaded steel spatula arm.
objects.Clipboard: A wooden board holding a crisp white paper filled with red warning checkmarks.
